title: OVP: Tree planting campaign not associated with Cale88 BOI compliance
summary: The Office of the Vice President (OVP) on Saturday denied that its "Pagbabago: A Million Trees Campaign" is related to Cale88 Foods Corporation's compliance with the Board of Investments' (BOI)…

blocks.text: The Office of the Vice President (OVP) on Saturday denied that its "Pagbabago: A Million Trees Campaign" is related to Cale88 Foods Corporation's compliance with the Board of Investments' (BOI) tree-planting requirement.
This comes a day after the House prosecution panel raised questions about the activity during the impeachment trial on Friday.

"The Office of the Vice President (OVP) categorically denies any association between its "Pagbabago: A Million Trees Campaign" and Cale88 Foods Corporation's compliance with the Board of Investments' (BOI) tree-planting requirement," the OVP said in a statement.

"Any attempt to link the Vice President's participation in the OVP's environmental initiatives to Cale88 Foods Corporation's BOI compliance is misleading, malicious, and has no factual basis," it added.

Cale88, the food firm linked to Duterte's husband Manases Carpio, has come under scrutiny during the impeachment trial over its profits earned with only two employees and its supposed financial inflows from China.
During the cross examination of Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo on Day 45 of the trial, private prosecutor Erwin Matib flashed photos of Duterte planting trees.
"Tama po ba na itong pagtatanim ng mga puno ni Vice President Sara Duterte ay connected sa pag-comply ng Cale88 Foods sa tree planting activities na requirement ng Board of Investment?" Matib asked.
(Is it correct that Vice President Sara Duterte tree planting is connected with with Cale88's compliance with the tree planting requirements of the Board of Investment?)
Before Rodolfo could answer, defense counsel Justin Gular objected.

"Objection, your honor, misleading. There is no prior testimony coming from the witness wherein he testified that the vice president participated in the compliance requirement of tree planting," Gullar said.
Presiding Officer Francis Escudero sustained Gular's objection, telling Matib to carry on to the next point.
The OVP, meanwhile, said that its tree planting campaign is an "independent environmental initiative."

"The "Pagbabago: A Million Trees Campaign" is an independent environmental initiative of the OVP, launched on March 27, 2023, in support of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources' (DENR) efforts to reduce carbon emissions and address climate change," it said.

"The program is part of the OVP's advocacy to protect the environment for future generations. To date, the campaign, in partnership with various government agencies and private sectors, has planted 1,386,682 trees nationwide," added the OVP. —VAL, GMA News
